newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 industry output up 1.4 pct-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 industry output up 1.4 pct-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in 1996 rose 1.4 percent from 1995, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The IBGE said the positive result was based on a recovery in industrial production in the second half of 1996.
Output in December fell 1.4 percent from November but was up 7.8 percent against December 1995, it said.
Production in 1996 decreased in eight of the 20 industrial sectors covered by the IBGE survey, with the mechanical sector showing the largest fall at 12.9 percent.
Output of durable consumer goods rose 11.2 percent, while semi- and non-durable goods increased three percent. Intermediate goods rose 2.7 percent, IBGE said.
In December, 14 of the 20 sectors in the survey experienced lower output, and only intermediate goods saw an increase, 0.7 percent, it said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
